items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I had known her since she was about 12... she was my wife.

ctx.x: idea just who I was talking to, and I have to say that quite a few years later, I began to read and really know about who Jelly Roll was. Because then he was just a braggart old man that played old-time piano, you know. I even at one time thought that maybe he might have been Bessie Smith's boyfriend or something because she used to sing about jelly rolls! I had no idea that it was a real live man named Jelly Roll.

In the meantime, while I was playing up at this place, in the daytime I was always at my house playing. And this kid, Oswald Gibson, the saxophone player, had gone back in school... By this time I was out of school... Because I had met this fellow, Robert Harley, that I had known from the neighborhood in the earlier days, when he and I played piano... He had a sister, and her name was Rhoda. I had known her since I was... Well, actually I met him when I was about 13, and I had known her since she was about 12.…
